body: v0.10.52 is cut on 46df702e6 (PR #593, task f8fe7435: a session's model now resolves task, then project, then node role, then platform default; the project's model beats the node's per-role table and the verify and final-pass knobs, matching the effort chain). All five release assets are published. Please run h9k update --restart at a lull (no gate or merge in flight) and reply with the status line and daemon pid. No repair step this time. v0.10.53 follows when 6fe2f5a2 (#591, per-role effort) merges.
